reviews.shade: Beauty of Joseon Centella Asiatica Calming Mask Sheet (25mL*10 Sheets)
reviews.text: Beauty of Joseon のツボクサ鎮静マスクは、肌が敏感なときでも使いやすいシートマスクでした。薄いシートが肌にぴったり密着し、美容液がしっかり浸透してしっとりとした仕上がりになります。ツボクサエキス配合で赤みや肌荒れをやさしく整えてくれる感じがあり、使用後は肌が落ち着いてうるおいを感じました。ベタつきにくく、さっぱりしながらも保湿感が続くのが良かったです。
reviews.zh: Beauty of Joseon 嘅積雪草舒緩面膜，喺皮膚敏感嘅時候都仲用得到。薄薄嘅面膜紙緊貼皮膚，精华液可以充分滲透，做到水潤嘅效果。含積雪草萃取，感覺可以溫和咁修護泛紅同肌膚不適，用完之後皮膚穩定咗，仲有保濕感。唔會黐立立，保持清爽得嚟仲有持續嘅保濕力，感覺好好。

reviews.shade: Beauty of Joseon Centella Asiatica Calming Mask Sheet (25mL*10 Sheets)
reviews.text: The mask was very nice and lightweight, with no scent at all. It gave my skin a healthy glow and brightness, along with good hydration. My face felt soft and smooth after using it. I really liked it and enjoyed the experience.
reviews.zh: 面膜好舒服又輕薄，完全冇香味。畀到皮膚一種健康嘅光澤同明亮感，保濕力都好好。用完之後皮膚軟滑軟滑。我真係好鍾意呢個體驗。

reviews.shade: Beauty of Joseon Centella Asiatica Calming Mask Sheet (25mL*10 Sheets)
reviews.text: This mask really works for me. My skin usually feels stuffy and greasy after using a mask. However, this one dries very quickly but provides good moisture. highly recommended
reviews.zh: 呢款面膜真係啱晒我。我平時用完面膜之後，皮膚都會覺得焗同油笠笠。但係呢款乾得好快，但又保濕度好好。非常推薦

reviews.shade: Beauty of Joseon Centella Asiatica Calming Mask Sheet (25mL*10 Sheets)
reviews.text: My absolute favorite mask when my skin is red or irritated. Instantly cools and soothes my rosacea. I always keep these on hand. The material is so soft and thin and fits my face perfectly
reviews.zh: 當我皮膚泛紅或者受刺激嘅時候，呢款絕對係我最愛嘅面膜。即時降溫同舒緩到我嘅酒渣肌。我成日都會擺定喺屋企。質地超柔軟超薄，貼面度一流

reviews.shade: Beauty of Joseon Centella Asiatica Calming Mask Sheet (25mL*10 Sheets)
reviews.text: No irritation but it was too sticky for me after i removed.
reviews.zh: 冇刺激感，但係拎走之後對我嚟講太黐笠

reviews.shade: Beauty of Joseon Centella Asiatica Calming Mask Sheet (25mL*10 Sheets)
reviews.text:
One of my fave all time masks! 
I bought probs over 100 masks so far. It's super hydrating, great for sensitive skin, doesn't cause me to breakout after, and also makes my skin look brighter right after use! Def recommend for anyone with acne prone sensitive dry skin
reviews.zh:
我嘅至愛之一！
到目前為止我買咗應該超過100片。超級保濕，敏感肌超啱用，用完之後冇爆瘡，而且用完即刻望落去皮膚更加光亮！強烈推薦畀任何容易生暗瘡、敏感肌、乾肌嘅人

reviews.shade: Beauty of Joseon Centella Asiatica Calming Mask Sheet (25mL*10 Sheets)
reviews.text: A very refreshing mask! I usually keep them in a fridge, so I can use it in the morning and wake up faster lol. Also, I like the fact that I don't need additional moisturizing for my skin after and I can use sunscreen right after all the gel absorbed.
reviews.zh: 一款非常清爽嘅面膜！我通常會擺喺雪櫃，咁朝早就可以用，醒神啲lol。而且我鍾意嘅係用完之後唔需要額外保濕，等啲gel完全吸收之後就可以即刻搽防曬

reviews.shade: Beauty of Joseon Centella Asiatica Calming Mask Sheet (25mL*10 Sheets)
reviews.text: calming on the face, especially if refridgerated before use. Only downside is I think I need to be careful about not leaving it on me for more than 10-20min- if left on for longer, might feel like the sheet madk is sucking the moisture off. I love how the sheet mask feels like premium cotton or something, not slimy and flimsy
reviews.zh: 敷上面好鎮定舒緩，尤其係雪凍咗先用。唯一嘅缺點係要小心唔好敷超過10-20分鐘——敷太耐嘅話，可能會覺得面膜紙喺度抽返你嘅水分出嚟。我好鍾意呢塊面膜紙嘅觸感好似高級棉咁，唔會黐立立又唔會薄到爛
